Later Published issue FHIR-18866 added an immunization/vaccination synonym clarification in the same paragraph without reversing or narrowing the historical-use statement. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision for FHIR-5893.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already satisfies the Jira request and no non-redundant source edit is needed.
